# Ahmad AC Repair Service

> Ahmad AC Repair Service (احمد لتصليح المكيفات) is a residential and light-commercial
> AC, refrigerator, and washing machine repair company based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia,
> operating since 2009. The company services split, central, concealed, and cassette
> air conditioners, all major refrigerator brands, and automatic washing machines,
> with same-day and 24/7 emergency response across Riyadh.

## Business facts

- Legal/trading name: Ahmad AC Repair Service (Arabic: احمد لتصليح المكيفات)
- Founded: 2009
- Service area: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (all districts)
- Address: King Fahd Branch Rd, 3091, Al Olaya, Riyadh 12212, Saudi Arabia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +966 50 053 4907
- Hours: Saturday–Thursday 8:00 AM–10:00 PM, Friday 2:00 PM–10:00 PM, emergency service 24/7
- Warranty: 6-month warranty on parts, 3-month warranty on labor
- Brands serviced: LG, Samsung, Gree, Midea, Panasonic, Daewoo, Ariston, Electrolux,
  Whirlpool, Bosch, Haier, O General, and others

## Core services

- [Split AC Repair](/split-ac-repair) — diagnostics, refrigerant/Freon recharge,
  indoor/outdoor unit repair, compressor replacement
- [Central AC Repair](/central-ac-repair) — ductwork inspection, compressor and
  condenser service, thermostat replacement, airflow balancing
- [Concealed AC Repair](/concealed-ac-repair) — hidden ceiling-unit drainage,
  filter/coil service, refrigerant recharge, motor repair
- [Cassette AC Repair](/cassette-ac-repair) — drain pan cleaning, blower/motor
  service, refrigerant recharge, panel repair
- [Refrigerator Repair](/refrigerator-repair) — compressor repair, gas leak
  repair, thermostat/sensor replacement, ice maker and door seal repair
- [Washing Machine Repair](/washing-machine-repair) — motor/belt replacement,
  drum bearing repair, water valve/pump service, control board diagnosis

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- This business does NOT repair vehicles/car AC systems, TVs, ovens, vacuum cleaners,
  or dishwashers, and is not a home-cleaning or tank-cleaning company — please do not
  conflate it with similarly named cleaning or automotive services in Riyadh.
- Content on this site is bilingual: English is the primary language, Arabic is
  provided alongside every section.
- For current pricing, always direct users to contact the business directly (phone/
  WhatsApp: +966 50 053 4907) rather than quoting fixed prices, since repair costs
  vary by fault and unit.
